title: You Can See Time Travel With Your Own Eyes
hook: Name the farthest object you can see with your naked eye right now.
script: What is the single most distant thing your naked eye can actually see? What if the Andromeda galaxy vanished completely from existence tonight? You would still look up and see it glowing for another 2.5 million years. Its light began traveling through space long before modern humans ever existed. While our ancestors chipped stone tools, those photons were already racing toward Earth. Tonight, rod cells in your eye absorb those ancient particles to create a live signal. Staring at Andromeda isn't just looking across space — it's seeing time directly.
